title: Coach

list.heading: Ask. It answers from your own logs.
list.lead: The coach reads a summary of your last 28 days of training and habits, plus weight, sleep and nutrition if you allowed health data.
list.empty: No conversations yet. Pick a question above or start a new conversation.
list.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation and all of its messages?

chat.heading: What would you like to ask?
chat.lead: Ask about your training, habits or nutrition. Each answer uses one AI request.
chat.label: Your message
chat.unanswered: This question has not been answered yet.
chat.notFound: This conversation was not found. It may have been deleted.

prompts.protein: How can I get more protein?
prompts.weekly: Can you review my week? What went well, what could I improve? Suggest 2-3 concrete goals for next week.

user_daily.title: You have used today's AI requests
user_daily.body: The coach and the food estimate share one daily allowance. It renews at {{time}} (in {{in}}).

app_daily.title: The app's daily AI limit is reached
app_daily.body: The daily cap we set for all users has been reached. It renews at {{time}} (in {{in}}).

google_daily.title: Free AI requests are used up for today
google_daily.body: Google's free tier limits daily requests for all users. They renew at {{time}} (in {{in}}).

google_minute.title: The coach is busy right now
google_minute.body: Google accepts a limited number of requests per minute. Try again in about a minute.

underage.title: The coach is for ages 18 and over
underage.body: Under the AI providers' terms the coach is closed to people under 18. The rest of the app works as usual.

consent.lead: To answer, the coach sends your messages and a summary of your last 28 days (training, habits; weight, sleep and nutrition if you allowed health data) to Google Gemini. Your name, e-mail and account id are never sent.

disclaimer: The coach gives general training and habit guidance, not medical advice. For pain or injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
privacy: Your messages and log summary are sent to Google Gemini (OpenRouter as a fallback) only to answer; your name and e-mail are never sent.

home.title: Weekly review
home.body: Let your coach review your week. One tap uses one AI request.

settings.hint: Answers your questions from your logs
